fullTitle: I will build verified B2B lead lists for Morocco, MENA and Africa
description:
Need a targeted list of decision-makers in Morocco, the Gulf or Francophone Africa — with emails that actually reach them?

I build verified B2B lead lists you can upload straight into Instantly, Apollo or Lemlist. Every row is researched and checked, not scraped blind.

WHAT YOU GET PER LEAD
Company name · website · contact name · job title · verified email · LinkedIn · city · country · phone (when available) · source URL

WHY MY LISTS DIFFER
Most cheap lists are bulk-scraped and half the emails bounce. I verify every address (SMTP/MX check), remove catch-all domains, and dedupe — so your bounce rate stays under 3%.

LANGUAGES & COVERAGE
I work from Morocco and research in Arabic, French and English, so I cover Morocco, the Maghreb, the Gulf and West Africa properly — including companies that only list contact info in Arabic or French.

Sectors I source: real estate, logistics, import/export, clinics, agencies, restaurants, e-commerce and more.

HOW TO ORDER
Message me first with your niche, country and how many leads you need. I will send a FREE sample of 5 leads so you can check the quality before paying anything.
